selectionReason: The next fifteen, in source-row order, of the 271 absent frozen rows at least one of whose KANJIDIC2 readings is used by an existing word article that declares the kanji (an automatic alignment of each word's kana against the kanji's readings), the rule announced on issue 60 after batch 136. No word article is added: 20 existing articles each gain one link to a new card. A card quizzes each reading that a declaring word article uses, unless the pinned JMdict marks the spelling as ateji or the reading as gikun; name-only readings are never quizzed; a reading type with no such reading gets an empty quizzed list. All fifteen pass, so none is set aside. The only other article text changes remove or narrow the sentences in 宴会, 崩す, 崩れる and 附属 that said 宴, 崩 or 属 had no kanji card. 226 rows of the 271 group, 11 rows whose declaring articles use none of their KANJIDIC2 readings, and 644 rows with no declaring article remain.
